product.description: Connect the VGA port on your HDTV or monitor directly to your DisplayPort® source without any extra adapters. This cable features a unique active digital-to-analog signal converter built right in. This high performance cable features fully shielded tin plated copper conduits and gold plated connectors.IMPORTANT!
